title: Google Ads Advertising Policies & Editorial Standards
overview: Google Ads Advertising Policies govern allowed content, editorial formatting, and sensitive advertising categories across all Google platforms to prevent misleading ads and legal violations.
coreConcepts: Four core policy pillars: Prohibited content, Prohibited practices, Restricted content, and Editorial standards
Three-strike system for egregious policy violations leading to account suspension
Advertiser Verification Program requiring business entity identification
Automated AI ad review combined with human reviewer escalations
features: Policy Manager in Google Ads UI displaying account-level policy restrictions
Pre-submission policy scanning via Google Ads API validateOnly flag
Appeals center for disputing automated false-positive policy disapprovals
Certificate application portal for Healthcare, Finance, and Gambling categories
bestPractices: Always run pre-flight policy checks on ad copy and landing page URLs before committing campaign drafts
Ensure destination URL is directly accessible with identical business branding
Include transparent physical business address, privacy policy, and working customer support contacts
Avoid sensationalized claims, excessive capitalization (FREE), or gimmicky punctuation
policies: Prohibited: Counterfeit goods, dangerous products, dishonest behavior, inappropriate content
Restricted: Healthcare & medicines, financial services, legal services, alcohol, gambling
Editorial: Spelling, grammar, capitalization, punctuation, and destination match requirements
limitations: Policy appeals can take 24 to 72 hours for manual review resolution
Egregious violations (circumventing systems, counterfeit) result in immediate permanent suspension without warning
Automated reviewers cannot interpret nuances in medical or legal terminology without certificates
commonIssues: Ad disapproval for 'Destination not working' due to temporary 500 error during crawler inspection
Disapproval for 'Misleading representation' when pricing or claims lack verifiable proof
Suspension for 'Circumventing systems' caused by malware or suspicious redirect scripts

troubleshootingGuide.resolution: Check server access logs for Googlebot IP addresses (ensure firewall does not block Googlebot user agent) and submit appeal
Obtain LegitScript certification and submit verification application via Google Ads Help Center
